correctness.rationale: Finite exhaustive proof: 65,535 nonzero forms in 1,075 explicit 72-group orbits, 252 smooth orbits via exact 4-chart characteristic-two Gröbner tests (16,020 forms). Two nonidentical rational hyperplane procedures agree on all 1,075 full 15-plane incidence bitsets and every group orbit preserves theta-count. A replayed certificate yields the exact (5208,8076,2556,120,60) distribution and exactly 3 four-plane maximizer orbits (18,36,6); rank-one union-of-rulings and rank-two conic characterizations are proved, not inferred from sample.

value.rationale: Theta-hyperplane incidence is a canonical, geometrically motivated genus-four divisor statistic. Its exact arithmetic F2 descent cannot be read off from classical 120 complex tritangents, 15 geometric characteristic-two theta-hyperplanes, or genus-four rational point counts. This complete natural linear-system classification gives a sharp bound, entire frequency vector and three distinct extremal orbit types, including different conic/ruling behavior.
